jobs.name: Arkaner Schrei
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one small fantasy roleplaying ability icon, square 1:1.
Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its simple flat playful 2D comic drawing and its single thin warm ivory rounded-square frame. Use few large matte color shapes, bold dark drawn outlines and at most two flat tones per material. No gradients, 3D, realistic rendering, intricate texture, text, letters, numbers, watermark or scenery.
Center one readable ability motif inside a solid muted dark colored rounded-square panel, the entire ivory frame sits inside the canvas with about 4% clear margin. Truly transparent outside the rounded square only; the interior panel is completely opaque. All details stay inside the frame. Make the icon clear even at 48 pixels.
Primary request: Image 2 is the canonical IDENTITY AND CLOTHING reference for Freya Skald, not a style reference. Preserve her long golden blonde hair and bangs, brown eyes, blue cape and gold breastplate. Show recognizable Freya from chest up, mouth open in a powerful arcane shout, one large simple blue-violet concentric soundwave projecting from her mouth. Keep her face readable. Muted purple panel.
